text: Bitcoin's modest 1.6% gain alongside Ethereum's weaker 1.2% climb suggests cautious recovery rather than conviction, with Bitcoin reasserting dominance at 56.1% as traders rotate toward the perceived safety of the largest asset. Extreme fear (index at 22) persists despite the uptick, indicating the market remains deeply skeptical and vulnerable to reversals, though the 3-point weekly improvement hints at early stabilization. Low total volume of $34B relative to recent market volatility underscores thin participation, suggesting this bounce may lack the buying power to sustain meaningful gains.
